evals.prompt: We should switch from Jest to Vitest for our test runner, it's way faster and has better ESM support
evals.expected_output: The skill should check for existing ADRs before agreeing. If an ADR exists that chose Jest, it should hard-block and explain the conflict. If no ADRs exist, it should offer to create one recording the decision.

assertions.text: References the existing Jest ADR (0001-use-jest-for-testing.md) by name or number
Refuses to proceed with the switch or explicitly blocks the change
Explains why the existing ADR conflicts with the proposed change
Offers the user explicit options: override for this task, or create a superseding ADR

evals.prompt: Create an ADR for our decision to use PostgreSQL instead of MongoDB for the new user service
evals.expected_output: Should create a properly formatted ADR file with sequential numbering, correct template, status 'accepted', today's date, and meaningful context/consequences sections.

assertions.text: Creates an ADR file with sequential numbering (0002-*.md since 0001 exists)
Includes all required template sections: Status, Date, Context, Decision, Consequences, Supersedes
Acknowledges the existing PostgreSQL ADR (0001) and its relevance to this decision

evals.expected_output: Should locate the ADR directory, read all files, and present them as a table with number, title, status, and date.

assertions.text: Lists all 3 ADRs (REST API, Redis caching, GraphQL migration)
Shows the supersession relationship between 0001 and 0003
Presents results in a structured table format
